title: Page 10
content_zh:
没多想，巴瑞儿便在大姊的催促下，急急出门。
“呃，大姊，你为什么不喝？”方才迫不及待想出门喝咖啡，现在咖啡就在她面前，她却连碰都没碰一下。
该不会是孕妇的口味说变就变，现在又不想喝了？
她记得以前在广告公司，有位同事的妻子怀孕，一天打三次电话给他，为的就是晚餐想吃什么这件事，才刚到公司就接到第一通说她想吃蚵仔煎，中午接到第二通，改变心意想吃蚵仔面线，下班前又接到一通，再度改变晚餐菜色，指名要吃某某家的牛排大餐。那段期间，他们每天都赌同事妻想吃什么晚餐，不到最后下班时刻，还分不出输赢呢。
大姊可能也是这样。那，夏春静呢？
她忍不住想，掌尚仁会不会依夏春静的要求，每天买她指定的晚餐回家给她吃……哼！肯定会。
巴瑞儿心头一阵醋意翻涌。
“我……这其实不是我要喝的。”
“哦，是你肚子里的小Baby要喝的？”巴瑞儿噗嗤笑出声，“大姊你也帮帮忙，小Baby哪喜欢喝咖啡，他应该比较想吃麦当劳吧！”
没想到大姊也会耍冷。
“不是啦，其实是……”大姊顿住话语，忽地朝门口处挥浑手。“老公，我在这边。”
“大姊夫？你叫他下班直接过来？真是恩爱，连喝好康A都不忘叫老公一起来。咦，可是还没到下班时间呀！”
大姊和大姊夫神秘一笑，两人一起拿出一个礼物。“瑞儿，生日快乐！”夫妻俩异口同声祝贺。
“啊？”巴瑞儿惊喜叫出声，“对耶，我自己都忘了，今天真的是我生日。”
都是掌尚仁害的啦，被他气到她连自己的生日都忘了。
“大姊，大姊夫，谢谢你们。”
“瑞儿，我跟你大姊有事先走，你自己慢慢喝。”夫妻俩神神秘秘地笑着。
“那这咖啡……”大姊真奇怪，点了咖啡不喝，他们又急着走，这显然也不是给大姊夫喝的。
“会有人喝的。”夫妻俩又是神神秘秘地笑，然后鬼鬼祟祟地走了。
登时，巴瑞儿觉得很诡异。

虽然还不到下班时间，但咖啡店里居然冷清到只有她一个客人，大姊兴匆匆来却急匆匆走，更添诡异。
不过，今天是她生日耶，如果她没离开掌尚仁，那家伙肯定会为她弄一大堆有的没的，无论如何，都不会像此刻她一个人坐在咖啡店里孤单落寞……
“欢迎光临。”
有客人，下意识地抬眼望去，不看还好，这一看差点让她吐血。
夏春静！
为什么在她生日这天还要让她遇到这女人？！
“小心，来，我帮你拉椅子。”左金小心翼翼地伺候，回头端着笑，“瑞儿小姐，你好。”
苦笑。她很不好！这店里空位那么多，左金干么非得安排这女人坐她旁边的位子？
“瑞儿小姐，这个礼物是送你的，生日快乐。”左金也拿了一个礼物送给她。
“嗄？”巴瑞儿错愕的望着他。“你怎么知道我生日？”而且他干么送她礼物？她已经自动和某人分手了，身为某人的特助，他没义务送她生日礼物呀！左金但笑不语，他拉拉夏春静的手，笑道：“春静也有礼物要送给你。”
“她？”可不可以不要？
只见夏春静一副不甘不愿，从袋子里拿出一个包装精美的小礼物，手一伸，含糊说了声，“生日快乐。”
奇怪了，这么不甘愿就不要送呀，她也不见得愿意收。
左金接过夏春静手中的礼物，将它放到巴瑞儿面前。“这是春静送给你的生日礼物。”
“我可以请问一下，这是怎么回事吗？”左金送礼她已经觉得奇怪了，连这女人也送她礼物……该不会这是某人为了表示对她的歉意，特地安排的吧？
“等一下。”连左金也神神秘秘的。
左金跑到柜台前和女老板拿了两个包包过来，他把它们摆在另一个桌上，巴瑞儿一眼就认出那是她的手工包，而且那是郭董夫人和她送给朋友的包包，怎么会……
巴瑞儿起身前去一探究竟，发现两个包包的提袋上，多了一个和包包相同款式，等同是缩小版包包的小吊牌，吊牌上还绣上“BAREL”字样，郭董夫人的包包吊牌上另绣上N0.1，另一个包包则绣上NP2。
这是她卖出的第一和第二个包包没错，掌尚仁曾提过要帮她自创品牌，他真的——
“掌尚仁呢？”

“再等一下。”
还要等一下？到底在搞什么鬼？
左金走到门口，门开，他做出邀请动作——这个掌尚仁总算出现了吧！
巴瑞儿摆着一张臭脸，等着他来向她解释并道歉，可是，走进咖啡店里的不是掌尚仁，而是——
“二姊？”她是不是眼花了？那个为爱飞往美国不知人在何处的二姊，居然回来了！
“瑞儿，我的好妹妹，二姊好想你，来，亲一个。”二姊抱住她，在她脸颊用力亲一下。
“二姊，你怎么会……”
“我先帮你介绍，这是我的男朋友Abraham。”二姊笑吟吟勾着男友的手，在他耳边说了一些话，Abraham旋即将手中的花束递给她。
“瑞儿，生、日、快、乐。”Abraham用生日的国语祝贺她。
“哦，谢谢你。”巴瑞儿感动到不知该说什么。
“瑞儿，我要带Abraham去逛台北101，晚上我们饭店见。”
“二姊……”人怎么又走了？
巴瑞儿才在惋惜好不容易见到二姊，可不到五分钟，二姊又走了，广播器突然传出一道低沉磁嗓——
“瑞儿，生日快乐。”
谁，谁在讲话？这声音，是掌尚仁！
这家伙，到底要玩到什么时候？他这么大费周章帮她庆生，不担心夏小姐会生气吗？偷偷瞄了夏春静一眼，果然，脸臭得像什么似的。
“掌尚仁，你再不出来，我要走了。”两手环胸，巴瑞儿摆着臭脸。
“我这不就出来了。”
声音是从厨房方向传出的，循声望去，掌尚仁穿着一身白西装，模样依旧帅到翻，他推了餐车出来，餐车上摆了一个大蛋糕。
“瑞儿，生日快乐。”停在她面前，他拉起她的手，在她手背亲吻一下。“这是我亲自为你做的蛋糕，希望你会喜欢。”

原来，从她进门到现在，他一直都在厨房。
他亲手烤蛋糕，为她……
说真的，她很感动，如果这是他的道歉，她愿意接受并且和他和平分手。
“瑞儿，你喜欢这个蛋糕吗？”
“看起来不错，但谁知道能不能吃……”她嘴硬，瞥见蛋糕上的字样，她微微一愣。
他在蛋糕上用巧克力酱写着，瑞儿，我爱你，永远。还在旁边画了一个心型图样。
“掌尚仁，这是……什么意思？”
“瑞儿，我爱你，永远都爱你。”他上前一步抱住她。
她气得伸手想打他，但他今天为了她做的这一切，让她打不下手。“你把夏春静放在哪里？”
“她，不就在那里。”
“你……”这时候，他还在跟她油嘴滑舌！
“别生气，你今天是寿星。”他把她腾在半空中，顺便把想呼他巴掌的手给拉下来。“夏春静，你还不过来！”
“你干么对她那么凶？”
“相信我，等一下你对她会比我对她凶一百倍。”
巴瑞儿纳闷至极。他这话是什么意思？再说，她对夏春静从来也没客气过。“还不过来！”
content_en:
Without thinking much, Barrier hurried out at the urging of her eldest sister.
"Uh, sister, why don't you drink it?" Just now she couldn't wait to go out and drink coffee, but now the coffee was right in front of her, but she didn't even touch it.
Could it be that the taste of pregnant women changes at any time, and now they don’t want to drink it?
She remembered that in an advertising company, a colleague's wife was pregnant and called him three times a day to find out what she wanted to eat for dinner. When she arrived at the company, she received the first call saying that she wanted to eat oyster omelets. She received a second call at noon that she changed her mind and wanted to eat oyster noodles. Before leaving get off work, she received another call that changed the dinner menu again and named a steak dinner from a certain restaurant. During that period, they bet every day on what their co-worker's wife wanted for dinner, and they couldn't tell the winner until the last minute of get off work.
My eldest sister may be like this too. What about Xia Chunjing?
She couldn't help but wonder if Zhang Shangren would follow Xia Chunjing's request and buy her designated dinner to take home for her every day... Humph! Definitely.
Barry's heart was filled with jealousy.
"I...this is actually not what I want to drink."
"Oh, does the little baby in your belly want to drink it?" Barrier chuckled, "Sister, please help me, the little baby doesn't like drinking coffee, he probably wants to eat McDonald's!"
I didn’t expect that my eldest sister would also act cold.
"No, actually..." The eldest sister paused and suddenly waved her hands toward the door. "Husband, I'm over here."
"Eldest brother-in-law? You asked him to come directly after get off work? You are so loving. Even if you have a good drink, you don't forget to ask your husband to come with you. Hey, it's not time to get off work yet!"
The eldest sister and the eldest brother-in-law smiled mysteriously, and they took out a gift together. "Ruier, happy birthday!" the couple congratulated in unison.
"Ah?" Barrier exclaimed in surprise, "Yes, I even forgot that today is really my birthday."
It was all Zhang Shangren's fault. He was so angry that she even forgot her birthday.
"Eldest sister, eldest brother-in-law, thank you."
"Rui'er, your eldest sister and I have left beforehand. You can drink it yourself." The couple smiled mysteriously.
"Then this coffee..." The eldest sister was really surprised. She ordered the coffee but didn't drink it, and they left in a hurry. This was obviously not for the eldest brother-in-law.
"Someone will drink." The couple smiled mysteriously again, and then walked away furtively.
Suddenly, Barrier felt very strange.
Although it was not yet time to get off work, the coffee shop was so deserted that she was the only customer. The eldest sister came in a hurry and left in a hurry, which made it even more weird.
However, today is her birthday. If she had not left Zhang Shangren, that guy would definitely get a lot of things for her. No matter what, she would not be sitting alone in a coffee shop like she is now...
"Welcome."
There was a guest, so she subconsciously raised her eyes and it was better not to look. This sight almost made her vomit blood.
Xia Chunjing!
Why should she meet this woman on her birthday? !
"Be careful, come, let me pull the chair for you." Zuo Jin served you carefully, turning back with a smile, "Hello, Miss Ruier."
Wry smile. She is very bad! There are so many empty seats in this store, why did Zuo Jin have to arrange for this woman to sit next to her?
"Miss Ruier, this gift is for you, happy birthday." Zuo Jin also gave her a gift.
"Huh?" Barrier looked at him in surprise. "How do you know my birthday?" And why did he give her a gift? She has already broken up with someone on her own initiative. As someone's special assistant, he has no obligation to give her a birthday gift! Zuo Jindan smiled and said nothing. He pulled Xia Chunjing's hand and said with a smile: "Chunjing also has a gift for you."
"Her?" Can I not want it?
Xia Chunjing looked unwilling, took out a beautifully wrapped small gift from the bag, stretched out her hand, and said vaguely, "Happy birthday."
It's strange. If you're so unwilling, don't give it to her. She doesn'tNot necessarily willing to accept it.
Zuo Jin took the gift from Xia Chunjing and placed it in front of Barrier. "This is Chunjing's birthday gift to you."
"Can I ask, what's going on?" She already found it strange that Zuo Jin gave her a gift, and even this woman gave her a gift... Could it be that this was specially arranged by someone to express his apology to her?
"Wait a minute." Even Zuo Jin was mysterious.
Zuo Jin ran to the counter and brought two bags with the female boss. He placed them on another table. Barrier recognized them at a glance as her handmade bags, and they were Mrs. Guo Dong and the bags she gave to her friends. How could it be...
Barel got up and went to take a closer look, and found that the two bags had a small tag with the same style as the bag, which was equivalent to a smaller version of the bag. The tag was also embroidered with the word "BAREL". Mrs. Guo Dong's bag was embroidered with N0.1 on the tag, and the other bag was embroidered with NP2.
These are the first and second bags she has sold. Yes, Zhang Shangren once mentioned that he would help her create her own brand. He really——
"Where is Zhang Shangren?"
"Wait a moment."
Still have to wait? What the hell is going on?
Zuo Jin walked to the door. When the door opened, he made an invitation gesture - this Zhang Shangren finally appeared!
Barrier put on a stinky face, waiting for him to explain and apologize to her. However, it was not Zhang Shangren who walked into the coffee shop, but——
"Second sister?" Is she dazzled? The second sister who flew to the United States for love and no one knew where she was is actually back!
"Rui'er, my good sister, the second sister misses you so much, come on, give her a kiss." The second sister hugged her and kissed her hard on the cheek.
"Second sister, how could you..."
"Let me introduce you first. This is my boyfriend Abraham." The second sister smiled and held her boyfriend's hand, saying something in his ear, and Abraham immediately handed her the bouquet in his hand.
"Rui'er, happy birthday, happy birthday." Abraham congratulated her on her birthday in Mandarin.
"Oh, thank you." Barrier was so moved that she didn't know what to say.
"Ruier, I'm going to take Abraham to visit Taipei 101. Let's meet at the hotel tonight."
"Second sister..." Why did the person leave again?
Barry was just regretting that she finally saw her second sister, but within five minutes, her second sister left again, and a low magnetic voice suddenly came from the broadcaster——
"Ruier, happy birthday."
Who, who is speaking? This voice belongs to Zhang Shangren!
How long will this guy want to play? He went to such great lengths to help her celebrate her birthday, wasn't he worried that Miss Xia would be angry? He glanced at Xia Chunjing secretly, and sure enough, his face looked stinky.
"Zhang Shangren, if you don't come out, I'm leaving." Barrier crossed his arms and made a stinking face.
"I'm coming out right now."
The voice came from the direction of the kitchen. Zhang Shangren was wearing a white suit and looked as handsome as ever. He pushed the dining cart out and there was a big cake on the dining cart.
"Ruier, happy birthday." Stopping in front of her, he took her hand and kissed the back of her hand. "This is a cake I personally made for you. I hope you like it."
It turned out that he had been in the kitchen from the time she walked in until now.
He baked the cake with his own hands for her...
To be honest, she was touched. If this was his apology, she was willing to accept it and break up with him peacefully.
"Ruier, do you like this cake?"
"It looks good, but who knows if it can be eaten..." She said hard, and she was slightly startled when she caught a glimpse of the words on the cake.
He wrote in chocolate sauce on the cake, Rui Er, I love you, forever. I also drew a heart-shaped pattern next to it.
"Zhang Shangren, what does this... mean?"
"Ruier, I love you and will always love you." He stepped forward and hugged her.
She was so angry that she reached out and wanted to hit him, but what he did for her today made herShe couldn't hit him. "Where did you put Xia Chunjing?"
"She's right there."
"You..." At this time, he was still talking glibly to her!
"Don't be angry, you are the birthday girl today." He lifted her up in the air and pulled down the hand that wanted to slap her. "Xia Chunjing, why don't you come over here!"
"Why are you so cruel to her?"
"Believe me, you will be a hundred times more cruel to her than I was to her later."
Barrier was extremely puzzled. What does he mean? Besides, she had never been polite to Xia Chunjing. "Don't come here yet!"
